title: RegexBuilder: Parse Log Lines
hints: `RegexBuilder` builds regexes with a result-builder DSL.
Use `Reference`s for captures, `ChoiceOf` for the level, and `TryCapture` with a transform for the code. Match with `wholeMatch`.
jsBridge: `RegexBuilder` is a result-builder DSL for regexes (`Capture { … }`, `TryCapture` with transforms), readable where regex literals get cryptic. JS has nothing comparable built in.
